task.title: Top paying customer in each country
task.statement:
Tables: `customers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, country TEXT)` and `orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount_cents INTEGER, status TEXT)`.

For each country that has at least one customer with a `'paid'` order, return one row: the country, the name of the customer whose paid orders add up to the most in that country, and that total in cents. Only orders with status `'paid'` count; orders whose customer does not exist count for nobody. If two customers of a country have the same total, the one with the smaller `id` wins. Columns, in order: `country`, `name`, `total`. Rows ordered by `country`.
